title: Provision clear does not revoke previously issued epoch metadata
description: Correctness review: ProvisionVerifier.clear() sets a flag but previously issued metadata remains accepted, and any later record() call—even malformed/untrusted input—silently clears the cleared state. Add a generation/revocation epoch so admin clear invalidates all prior metadata, and only a separately authenticated replacement/install transition exits cleared state. Cover stale metadata and malformed record attempts.
